changelog:
- Added details about pausing and resuming taps, including new status values and how pausing affects rules and matches.
- Expanded tap deletion guidance: deletions are immediate and permanent; recommends using pause for temporary stops.
- Improved rule deletion guidance: emphasizes confirmation since deletions are immediate and matches stop instantly.
- Updated SKILL description to clarify use for Firehose API or firehose.com tasks (tap management, rules, streaming).
- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md.
summary: Firehose monitors the web in real-time — you create rules (Lucene queries), and every crawled page that matches gets delivered via an SSE stream. Use for work on the Firehose API or firehose.com — managing taps, writing rules and match queries, or consuming the SSE match stream.
